Supplied information and construction st: Topology, primitive coordinates, molecular-symmetry operations and atom permutations are supplied and retained. Ring, fragment, interaction-center, and continuous-perception information may also be supplied.
A TOPOLOGY section specifies covalent connectivity; ordinary redundant primitives are then generated from it.
A PRIMITIVES section specifies the ordered redundant coordinate functions; their atom indices, values, and analytic Wilson B matrix rows are checked against the geometry.
The included perception procedure supplies ordinary topology, molecular symmetry with atom permutations, and primitive coordinates.
